description: This bar chart illustrates the task count for different language families across several BERT models. The horizontal axis displays language family categories labeled “IE-Baltic”, “IE-Germanic”, “IE-Indic”, “IE-Romance”, “IE-Slavic”, “IE-other”, “Isolate”, “Semitic”, and “Uralic”, presented in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “task count”, represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40, with tick marks at intervals of 10.  For each language family, there are three bars representing different BERT models: mBERT (light green), XLM-R (medium teal), and better (dark blue). The “better” model bar for “IE-Slavic” reaches approximately 38, representing the highest value in the chart, while the “better” model bar for “Isolate” is the shortest, reaching approximately 2. The mBERT bars generally range from approximately 8 to 22, while the XLM-R bars range from approximately 10 to 30. The bars are grouped by language family, with each group containing one bar for each of the three BERT models. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
